source: Jane (default speaker), published NATURAL word_clips, measured contours, pulled 8 Oct 2026 (after natural placement with textbook's chao map) with: select w.id, w.tones, c.onset_s, c.duration_s, c.contour from words w join word_clips c on c.word_id = w.id join speakers s on s.id = c.speaker_id where s.is_default and c.style = 'natural' and c.status = 'published'. Every 4th single-syllable word per tone by id, and the first 3 two-syllable words (by id) per non-neutral combo. contour = [[t, chao]] with t a 0..1 fraction of the tone window (durationS long); voiced frames only.
averageSource: The natural words make-tone-averages averages (the live catalog query, CATALOG_SELECT, published natural takes of words that also have a published textbook take), their polylines — for rebuilding an average without one clip.
